subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap — scope, metrics, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenhealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ZenHealth discovery — post-call recap & proposed POC kickoff

Hi Laura / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed scope for the pilot/POC so we can kick off next week. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes during peak usage (95th pct often > 700ms for user-facing flows).
- Cost is unpredictable with current provider and spikes on long-context jobs.
- PHI concerns — you need a deployment option that keeps logs and models inside your VPC for compliance.
- Quality: hallucinations on medication instructions in ~6% of responses; you want guardrails and deterministic prompt evals.

Goals for POC
- Achieve 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short-form assistant flows (<= 256 tokens).
- Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by ~30% vs current baseline.
- Demonstrate secure telemetry & audit logs stored in your AWS account (no egress of PHI).
- Improve factual accuracy on the clinical prompt set (target F1 uplift >= 8 points).

Proposed POC scope (3 weeks)
1) Setup & access (days 0-2)
  - VPC peering / Private deployment access: ZenHealth to grant AWS account ID and subnets; Redwood to provision Private control plane.
  - Service account + S3 bucket access for prompt/eval artifacts.
  - Contact: Aditya (infra) will share technical checklist.
2) Baseline & metrics (days 2-6)
  - Ingest your sample prompt set (attached prompt_examples.csv).
  - Run baseline inference on our hosted model variant and collect latency/cost/quality baselines.
3) Optimization & tests (days 7-14)
  - Apply batching, KV caching, and quantization profile; measure changes.
  - Run prompt eval suite and produce quality report.
4) Final report & handoff (days 15-21)
  - Deliver performance dashboard, runbook for production rollout, and recommendation for Dedicated vs Private.

Owners
- Redwood: Marissa (sales/pm), Rishi (solutions engineering), Aditya (infra/setup).
- ZenHealth: Laura (product lead), Tom (engineering lead).

Immediate next steps
- Laura/Tom: confirm access for AWS account ID + S3 path and availability for kickoff meeting (30-45m) next week.
- ZenHealth procurement: if needed, we can start the security questionnaire in parallel (team noted SOC 2 + vendor security questionnaire).
- Redwood: I attached a one-page POC scope and the prompt_examples.csv.

Attachments: zenhealth_poc_scope.pdf (POC scope), zenhealth_prompt_examples.csv (prompt set sample)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite after I get your preferred kickoff slot.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenhealth.com>

Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@zenhealth.com>, Sofia Martins <sofia.martins@zenhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenHealth discovery — post-call recap & proposed POC kickoff

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with our internal notes. A few clarifications / asks from our side:
- The 95th pct latency target looks good; can you confirm whether that includes network RTT for VPC deployment?
- We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and the completed vendor security questionnaire prior to any Private deployment. I attached our procurement intake form and the vendor security questionnaire to this reply (vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf).
- Procurement has asked for an estimated contract value for the 3-week POC (ballpark). Can Redwood provide a not-to-exceed estimate so we can route approval?

Availability: Tom and I are available Mon/Tue afternoon next week (PST) for a 30m kickoff.

Thanks — Laura

-
Laura Chen
Director, Product — ZenHealth

Date: 2027-06-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenHealth discovery — post-call recap & proposed POC kickoff

Laura —

Great — quick answers and next steps:
- Latency: the 95th percentile target is measured end-to-end from our inference API. For Private (VPC) deployments we’ll provide both host-level and end-to-end metrics so you can separate network RTT. Rishi will add the exact measurement definitions to the runbook.
- Security docs: we’ve attached Redwood’s SOC 2 summary and I’ve looped in Neha (security) to respond to the vendor questionnaire.
- POC cost: For an apples-to-apples estimate, the POC (3 weeks, dedicated infra + engineering support) is typically $12,000 USD not-to-exceed. We can bill as a short-term professional services engagement or roll into a pilot contract.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday 2027-06-29 2:00pm PST (30m) — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Action items assigned
- ZenHealth: share AWS account ID + S3 bucket path (Laura) — due EOD 2027-06-26.
- Redwood: Aditya to send technical checklist + VPC peering steps (Aditya) — due 2027-06-26.
- Redwood: Neha to start vendor questionnaire responses (Neha) — due 2027-06-28.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/zen-456), POC folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zenhealth-poc)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

-
